name: ai-seo
description: Check whether AI answers mention your brand in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews. In Claude Code, creates llms.txt and AI crawler rules in robots.txt, showing the diff before each change. With no data yet, it writes buyer prompts and a log sheet you run yourself; paste answers back to see how often you show up or get recommended, how you are described and which sites are cited instead. One question where a rival is quoted: compare those answers with your page. AI states your prices or audience wrong: plan corrections on the sites it cites. Also reviews one page (URL or pasted text) with rewrites, Bing, Search Console or GA4 AI exports, and AI bot access. Contains no code of its own and stores nothing.
